queries: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM races), s AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total AS share FROM c CROSS JOIN t) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS margin_above_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(race_count) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, c.race_count / t.total AS share, c.race_count / t.total - 1.0 / t.n AS margin_above_avg_share FROM c, t WHERE c.race_count / t.total > 1.0 / t.n ORDER BY margin_above_avg_share DESC, c.circuitId LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races, COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) AS n_circuits FROM races) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races AS share, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races - 1.0 / t.n_circuits AS share_above_avg FROM c CROSS JOIN t ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races FROM races), n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_circuits FROM circuits) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races AS share, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races - 1.0 / n.n_circuits AS share_above_avg FROM c CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN n ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM races), s AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total AS share FROM c CROSS JOIN t) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS margin_above_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average circuit's share is the mean of per-circuit shares across circuits that have at least one race, which equals 1/number of circuits. Circuits with no races are excluded.
Every row in races counts as one race, with no filtering by year.
'How far above' is the absolute difference in share (share minus average share), not a ratio.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(race_count) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, c.race_count / t.total AS share, c.race_count / t.total - 1.0 / t.n AS margin_above_avg_share FROM c, t WHERE c.race_count / t.total > 1.0 / t.n ORDER BY margin_above_avg_share DESC, c.circuitId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average circuit's share is 1 / (number of distinct circuits that have hosted at least one race), i.e. the mean of the shares across circuits in races. Circuits with no races are excluded.
Every row in races counts as one race, including any non-championship races that the table contains.
The margin is expressed in share units (share minus average share), not as a ratio.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races, COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) AS n_circuits FROM races) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races AS share, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races - 1.0 / t.n_circuits AS share_above_avg FROM c CROSS JOIN t ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Circuits are those appearing in races (circuits with zero races are excluded), so the average circuit share is 1 / number of distinct circuits in races, i.e. the mean of the shares.
Margin is share minus average share (a difference in share, not a ratio); ties are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: Average share computed over all circuits in the circuits table, including those that never hosted a race (average = 1 / count of circuits rows).
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races FROM races), n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_circuits FROM circuits) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races AS share, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races - 1.0 / n.n_circuits AS share_above_avg FROM c CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN n ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
